data.name: ListingNewPullRequestText
data.value: GitHub opens a new file in your own copy of content-index, and then the pull request form. GitHub fills in this text when it fits in the link. When it is too long, Borea copies it, and you paste it into the page. The pull request merges itself when you control the release host: the repository is yours, has the topic ksa-index-<your GitHub name>, or contains .github/ksa-content-index.toml. A SpaceDock mod proves this through the GitHub repository in its source code link.
